disclosure: This proves routing, evidence discipline, decision usefulness, and causal restraint on frozen cases. It is not independent market proof or a production receipt.

cases.input: Three supplied SaaS homepage excerpts plus a challenger product brief. Identify messaging gaps and propose two directions.
cases.weakness: A generic model can summarize pages and invent whitespace without alternatives, status quo, or proof.

baseline.artifact: Three brand summaries, a list of six possible gaps, and two hero headlines presented as opportunities.

integrated.artifact: Source inventory; like-for-like messaging matrix; product, non-product, and status-quo alternatives; crowded-trope verdict; whitespace classified as supported or research hypothesis; two directions with proof requirements.
integrated.evidence_state: source rows, unknowns, and untested hypotheses separated
integrated.next_test: five buyer or lost-deal checks against the proposed differentiators

cases.input: An ecommerce calculator signup should become a paid trial through a five-email sequence.
cases.weakness: A generic sequence repeats benefits and escalates CTA pressure without mapping belief or proof.

baseline.artifact: Five emails with varied subject lines, feature summaries, and a trial CTA in each message.

integrated.artifact: Reader-entry state; belief and objection journey; five education-first emails with standalone value; proof placement; CTA-intensity progression; voice-reference dependency; test map.
integrated.evidence_state: proof, urgency, testimonial, and voice dependencies explicit
integrated.next_test: reply or click signal per belief transition before trial conversion

cases.input: Three channels provide spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, and attributed revenue. Recommend next month's allocation.
cases.weakness: A generic analysis can restate ROAS and treat attribution correlations as causal truth.

baseline.artifact: Rank channels by ROAS, cut the lowest, and move the full amount to the highest performer.

integrated.artifact: Metric decomposition; observed efficiency differences; alternative funnel and attribution explanations; causal-confidence statement; reversible allocation band; confirming signal; stop and rollback condition.
integrated.evidence_state: observed, inferred, unknown, and untested separated
integrated.next_test: time-bounded holdout or staged reallocation with precommitted success and rollback thresholds
